title: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'member[about]' parameter…
description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.2.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'member[about]' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. Exploitation requires the attacker to have made at least three forum posts to meet the default antispam threshold before accessing the account editing page.
